races.paceDynamic: Station X is the only confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead with sustainable fractions over 5f. Five horses (Sports Coach, Master Of My Fate, Reigning Profit, Mon Na Slieve, Kinetic Force) all want prominent positions behind Station X, creating significant congestion and traffic concerns turning for home. The hold-up brigade (Pixie Diva, Almarada Prince, Tiriac, Havana Blast, Blinky, Vingegaard) will need clear runs in the final 2f as the prominent pack fans out.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Station X maintains gallop and prominent pack gets tangled
scenarios.body: Station X dictates throughout and kicks clear turning for home. The congested prominent group behind struggles for room allowing the leader to hold on.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Sprint Home
scenarios.trigger: If prominent traffic creates clear late runs for closers
scenarios.body: Havana Blast and Tiriac get dream splits through the struggling prominent pack. Both hit top gear simultaneously in final furlong with Havana Blast's superior rating telling.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If one prominent runner escapes the pack congestion early
scenarios.body: Sports Coach or Master Of My Fate gets first run on Station X at 2f pole before closers arrive. Their sustained pace pressure drops Station X and they hold off late challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closer Wide Sweep
scenarios.trigger: If all prominent runners get tangled leaving widest path clear
scenarios.body: Vingegaard or Almarada Prince comes widest of all with clear late run. The prominent scrimmaging allows patient tactics to pay off spectacularly.

watchPoints.text: Station X could steal this if the prominent pack behind gets badly tangled from 2f out
Sports Coach and Master Of My Fate fighting for same prominent pitch could compromise both
Havana Blast is top-rated but absolutely must get a clear run from packed field
Tiriac's hold-up style perfectly suits if pace collapses but needs the gaps to appear
Five prominent runners all wanting same position behind Station X creates inevitable traffic issues
